profile.name: Tadiwanashe Marumani
profile.writeup:
Tadiwanashe Marumani is a Zimbabwean international cricketer who was born on 2nd January 2002. Marumani is a left-handed middle-order batter who made his first-class debut in 2021, for Southern Rocks, in the 2020-21 Logan Cup. Prior to his first-class debut, he was named in Zimbabwe's squad for the 2020 Under-19 World Cup. He made his T20 debut in the following year, for Rocks, in the 2020-21 Zimbabwe Domestic T20 Competition.

In February 2022, during the 2021-22 Logan Cup, Marumani scored his maiden century in first-class cricket. Marumani made his international debut on 21st April 2021, for Zimbabwe against Pakistan in a T20I and soon received his ODI cap as well.
